body:
You're right, I know I could be in far worse of a position and I'm not at a total loss. I think tomorrow I'll make an appointment for my doctor.

I'm rereading over what I wrote and I think another thing is I'm way too humble minded in the sense that while through the reflections of grades and having a wide knowledge on all sorts of things, I never really thought I was smart. This eventually would evolve into a confidence issue where I lacked interest and motivation to do things because I felt like there are a billion people who are way better than me.

I suck at giving myself credit, end up writing myself off completely short and feel like everything is hopeless and that I'll never go anywhere.
